title: Unique Springy Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: This dish combines the flavors of Morocco with the freshness of spring, featuring a sweet and tangy sugar syrup and a papillote cooking method, making it a macrobiotic-friendly option. It is perfect for a rainy monsoon evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cut a piece of parchment paper into a large square and place the chicken in the center.
Drizzle the sugar syrup over the chicken and fold the parchment paper into a papillote.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
